name: WC Quick Customer Redirects
author: theorcawp

sections.description:
This plugin lets you set custom page redirects for customers after registration, login, logout actions.

Pro Version Features

The Pro version of WC Quick Customer Redirects expands on these features by offering:

  • Custom Link Options: In addition to internal page selection, you can enter custom URLs (including external links) for registration, login, and logout redirection.
  • Add-to-Cart Redirects: Set up redirection rules for add-to-cart actions, with the choice of internal page selections or custom URLs.
  • Checkout Redirects: Configure a checkout redirect feature that automatically redirects customers a specified number of seconds after checkout is complete.
  • Comprehensive Product Compatibility: Works with all core product types—including bookings and subscriptions—and supports redirection on a per-variation level for variable products.

You can see that at WooCommerce Customer Redirects Pro
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin & install it to your wp-content/plugins folder (or use the Plugins menu through the WordPress Administration section)
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Navigate to ** WooCommerce > Settings > Account **.
  4. Set your custom redirect pages.
  5. Save and enjoy!
sections.faq:
Q: What happens if I don’t set any custom redirects?

A: Then customers that register will be redirected to the shop page (default), and customers logging in/out will be redirected to the my-account page (default).

Q: What about shop manager / admin roles? Will this affect login/logout for them?

A: No! Users that have shop manager / admin roles will automatically be redirected to the wp-admin dashboard.

Q: Where to get support

A: Reach out to support at Orca WP Support
